notes.zh: 修正原生高斯漫游：前后左右在水平面移动，高度独立；新增左右双摇杆和中间升降控制，支持同时移动与观察。控制器叠放在画面内，不再挤压视口，工具栏与按钮改为紧凑平面样式。需要覆盖安装完整 APK，保留项目与书签。
notes.en: Fix native Gaussian navigation: planar forward/strafe, separate height, move/look thumb pads and independent rise/lower controls. Simultaneous inputs are supported. Overlay controls keep the viewport size unchanged; streamline toolbar styling. Install the full APK; projects and views remain.
